author: Eric Skovan
text: Sorry, there is no widespread issue of Abbott’s sensors failing. I’ve been using them for five years and have only ever sent one back (and that was actually completely my fault)..

author: Connor Hutton
text: That definitely isn’t normal but can happen I suppose. Issues can happen. Delivery for me for the last few sensor issues has taken well over 1 week before it was 2 days and this seems to be the norm in the uk/Ireland at the minute

author: Fatemeh Ravanbakhsh
text: Thanks for sharing this detailed summary. From what you describe, these repeated sensor failures and errors definitely aren’t normal or acceptable, especially when they disrupt day-to-day monitoring like this. I’ve seen similar reports from others, too, which is why there’s growing attention on improving CGM reliability. If you haven’t already, I’d recommend documenting everything and reporting it directly to the manufacturer and your healthcare provider. These issues must be recognized and addressed. Stay strong — you’re not alone in this.
